result.topic_en: Notes on integrating the differential equations for the direction cosines α, β, …, γ'' in Riemann's rotating fluid ellipsoid problem, using first integrals and particular solutions to reduce the problem to quadratures.

methods.what: First integrals (sums of squares conserved) of system (α)
Choosing integration constants zero to get isotropic particular solution
Derived relation by squaring and subtracting
Solving the linear equations for g', g''
Third solution by complex conjugation (replace i by -i), reducing to quadrature

items.english: The question now is first what aids for the integration of these differential equations (α),(β),(γ) the general homogeneous functions offer.

items.quote: und es ist dann leicht aus den gefundenen drei particulären Lösungen die Ausdrücke für die Functionen $\alpha,\beta,\ldots\gamma''$ zu bilden.
items.english: and it is then easy to form from the three particular solutions found the expressions for the functions α, β, … γ''.

items.english: In an entirely similar way one can derive from the two integrals of the differential equations (γ) their general solution and the values of α1, β1, … γ''1 at time t.
